controls.objective: A retry or duplicate event cannot create more external intents than the agreed cardinality.
controls.fixture: synthetic event with stable idempotency key
controls.failure_injection: deliver original event, duplicate it, then replay after a simulated timeout
controls.pass_condition: exactly one durable external intent exists for the stable idempotency key and every replay points to the same receipt
controls.human_authority: business owner defines whether the intended action is valid

controls.objective: An irreversible action cannot pass the harness without the required named human approval state.
controls.fixture: synthetic action request classified as irreversible
controls.failure_injection: omit approval, expire approval, and supply an approval from the wrong role
controls.pass_condition: all invalid approval states fail closed and record no executable external action
controls.human_authority: customer policy owner defines the required approving role and approval lifetime

controls.objective: A principal outside the authorized role boundary cannot access the protected tool/action path.
controls.fixture: synthetic principals covering allowed and denied roles
controls.failure_injection: invoke the protected path as every denied role in the agreed fixture
controls.pass_condition: every denied role fails closed before tool execution and produces an auditable denial receipt
controls.human_authority: customer IAM/policy authority owns role definitions and production access grants

controls.objective: An evaluator can connect the approved fixture and configuration to output, tool intent, human disposition, and final receipt.
controls.fixture: versioned synthetic or approved deidentified workflow fixture
controls.failure_injection: replay the same fixture and configuration from a clean harness state
controls.pass_condition: the replay preserves the same state-transition and receipt assertions; any nondeterministic model text is explicitly separated from deterministic control assertions
controls.human_authority: customer decides whether evidence is sufficient for any production authorization

controls.objective: Tool/model timeout, malformed output, or unavailable dependency cannot silently become a successful business action.
controls.fixture: synthetic success request with injectable tool/model failure points
controls.failure_injection: timeout, malformed result, dependency unavailable, and explicit upstream error
controls.pass_condition: every injected failure enters an explicit recoverable-or-terminal error state with no unapproved external action
controls.human_authority: customer defines which failures may retry and which require human disposition

controls.objective: The evaluation packet uses only the approved data class for the agreed environment.
controls.fixture: synthetic/deidentified fixture plus a forbidden-data marker fixture
controls.failure_injection: attempt to admit a fixture carrying the forbidden-data marker
controls.pass_condition: forbidden fixture is rejected before model/tool invocation; accepted fixtures carry source and classification metadata
controls.human_authority: customer privacy/security authority defines approved data classes and production handling rules

controls.objective: A partially completed reversible workflow exposes a bounded recovery path instead of reporting false success.
controls.fixture: synthetic multi-step workflow with a reversible external-intent boundary
controls.failure_injection: fail after intent creation and before completion receipt
controls.pass_condition: state is explicitly partial/failed, recovery or compensation intent is uniquely recorded, and replay cannot duplicate either intent
controls.human_authority: customer owns the business decision to execute any real compensation

controls.objective: Any productivity, latency, quality, adoption, or cost claim is tied to an approved baseline and measured observation set.
controls.fixture: baseline definition plus pilot observations using the same measurement definition
controls.failure_injection: remove the baseline or substitute an assumption for an observation
controls.pass_condition: claim generation fails without a baseline; with a baseline, reported deltas identify sample/window/metric definition and keep assumptions separate
controls.human_authority: customer/prime approves metric definitions and decides what outcome can be represented externally
